scenes.narration: One evening, in a cozy little town, a curious boy named Milo was playing in the forest.
Under a big oak tree, Milo found a tiny star, dim and sad, lying in the grass.
The little star whispered, 'I lost my glow. Can you help me find my way home?'
Milo knew they had to reach the highest hill, so they set off on a grand adventure.
Along the way, they met a rabbit, an owl, and a deer, all eager to help.
Together, they climbed the hill, and the star's glow grew stronger with every step.
At the top, Milo held the star high, and it sparkled like never before.
With a gentle whoosh, the star flew back to the sky, leaving a trail of sparkles.
Milo smiled, knowing he had a friend in the sky forever.
